title: Hello Python: the REPL and scripts

blocks.body:
## Interpreted and interactive

Python runs top-to-bottom. The **REPL** (`python`) lets you experiment line by line; scripts run with `python app.py`.

## No boilerplate

No class or main required. The common entry guard is `if __name__ == "__main__":` so a file can be both imported and run.

## Indentation is syntax

Blocks are defined by indentation (4 spaces), not braces. Consistency is mandatory.
